title: Heart Rate Optimal
description: HR 78. Dread 78. Same number, different app. The chorus would like to go to ninety; the watch does not approve.
stylePrompt: Spa-pop / wellness-notification ballad at exactly 78 BPM. Warm Rhodes, soft analog pad, glass-chime notification as snare. Kick is a watch haptic — a single polite tap, never a club kick. Close-mic spoken-sung female, professionally calm, Justine-adjacent, zero vibrato, never belted. A second voice (the watch) is a narrow, slightly brighter chime-vocoder that only says “elevated” and “optimal.” No guitar heroics. No drop. **Structural flaw:** tempo is locked at 78 because that is the watch’s optimal; any attempted chorus swell is cut by the same three-note chime, and the word “elevated” arrives on the downbeat even though nothing sped up. Mood: a heart-rate alert that thinks it is a ballad. Runtime ~1:30–1:50. Use a dry close female lead; optional Jackalyn whisper on the last “correct”; do not use Continuity Voice.
lyrics:
[Intro — haptic tap]
Heart rate: seventy-eight.
Existential dread: also seventy-eight.
This is optimal.

[Verse 1]
My watch says I am stressed. Correct.
The rally is not a workout. The paddle is not a tool.
I closed the ring by standing still.
The app congratulates the stillness.

[Pre-Chorus]
Optimal.
(chime)
Elevated.
(same tempo)

[Chorus]
Heart rate optimal
Dread optimal
Same number
Different app
Do not stand. Do not sit. Do not win.
This is a wellness event.

[Verse 2]
Jackalyn’s wrist keeps lighting the table
Justine eats a cracker like a verdict
The robot wants to feel. I want to finish my latte.
We all have needs. The watch has goals.

[Pre-Chorus]
Optimal.
(chime)
Elevated.
(same seventy-eight)

[Chorus 2 — attempted swell, same BPM]
Heart rate optimal
Dread optimal
Same number
Different app
The chorus would like to go to ninety
The watch does not approve

[Bridge — haptic only for two bars]
It is not a spatial rift
It is a disruption in the wellness vertical
Stand to log the hour
Sit to log the dread
Both are seventy-eight

[Final]
Heart rate optimal
Dread optimal
Same number
Different app
(chime: elevated)
Correct.
This is optimal.
notes:
## What the song is
A **wellness notification** that wandered onto the Episode 3 ladies. The watch is sincere. Justine is correct. Jackalyn’s wrist keeps lighting the table. Pong-Bot would like to feel. Nobody removes the watch. The number does not change.

The joke is the metric, not the panic. Nobody says “satire.” Nobody throws the watch.
